title: Stir Fry Beef Fajitas
description: A quick and flavorful Mexican stir fry dish made with tender beef and crunchy vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of argentinian chimichurri sauce to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the sliced beef to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside to rest.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the crunchy peanut butter to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Add the fajita seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked beef back to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and peanut butter.
Warm the crusty flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by slicing the cooked beef and vegetables and serving with the warmed tortillas, shredded cheese, and sour cream (if using).
